question: Is there an official registry of registered/certified tourist guides usable for San Luis Potosí?
summary: SECTUR runs the official national directory of accredited guides (NOM-08-TUR-2002 / NOM-09-TUR-2002), filterable by state (San Luis Potosí), municipality, guide type and language. The state's own guide page (visitasanluispotosi.com/guias-de-turistas/) is blocked and has no archived copy.

sources.what: Directory search form: inpEstado (24 = San Luis Potosí), inpMunicipio, inpTipoGuia, inpIdioma.
sources.not_done: Not queried. Results are personal data (names, credential numbers).

sources.what: Accreditation program: Guía General (NOM-08), Guía Especializado en temas o localidades culturales (NOM-08), Guía Especializado en actividades específicas — naturaleza/aventura (NOM-09).
State RNT procedures; provider categories include 'Operadora de Aventura Naturaleza'. No public list.

brochure_guidance.value: Se recomienda contratar los servicios de un guía certificado y reservar tours con anticipación.
brochure_guidance.note: Same tip in all four regional brochures.

brochure_guidance.value: Los sitios turísticos y parajes tienen una capacidad de carga limitada.

operators.note: No official public operator list found. The RNT is the registry; its official public consultation URL was not confirmed in this pass.

recommendation: On the site, link to the SECTUR directory (filtered to San Luis Potosí) and explain how to check a credential. Do not list named guides without their consent and a fresh check in the directory.
